t: Buying NFC Tags - Seritag
s: January 17, 2025 - Bigger chips doesn't equal better performance The most popular range of NFC tags include the NTAG series chips. It's important to note that the larger memory NTAG215/216 do not perform any better than the smaller NTAG210/212/213 chips. And, if you are storing a short web address/URL then the cheap NTAG210micro chip can work just as well. Bigger isn't better. (Be careful with fake chips on MIFARE Ultralight products though) Careful of import tax / delays Clearly, you should be buying your tags from Seritag but if you are buying your NFC tags/products from eBay or Amazon then firstly be very careful and secondly be aware that the shipment might be directly from Asia.
